ValidationRule.description: Desde el estado Draft, los campos Cliente, Opportunity Name, Close Date, Currency tienen que estar rellenos

ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please check the fields that are not completed: Client name, Opportunity Name, Need's Description, BBVA Countries Participants, Estimated Closing Date and Currency. It is necessary to fill them in order to advance the stage.
